skills.name: Nyanko-sensei's Protection (猫老师的守护)
skills.description: Natsume & Nyanko-sensei's damage received is decreased by 40%. When they receive damage, Nyanko-sensei has a 60% chance to transform into Madara (once before the start of their turn). If they are the only ones remaining on the battlefield, Nyanko-sensei will transform into Madara at the end of turn. ;Madara (斑) : :Madara attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 45% of their ATK with each attack. After attacking, Madara will transform back into Nyanko-sensei. The next time he transforms, each attack will also decrease the enemies' move bar by 5%.

upgrades.text: Madara's damage dealt to monsters is increased to 60%.
Madara's damage dealt to monsters is increased to 80%.

skills.name: Healing Medicinal Herbs (疗愈的草药)
skills.description: At the start of battle, Natsume & Nyanko-sensei gain 4 Medicinal Herbs stacks. ;Upon Usage :They gain 2 Medicinal Herbs stacks and the healing effect for the Healing is increased by 12% of their ATK, lasts for 2 turns. ;Medicinal Herbs (草药) : :Max of 6 stacks. Each stack increases their RES by 10%, consuming a stack increases their move bar by 5%.

upgrades.text: When they have 4 or more Medicinal Herbs, increases all allies' ATK by 24%.

bio.condition: With Natsume & Nyanko-sensei clear any zone 30 times.
